title: U.S. Heat Illness First Aid (NIOSH)
description: A searchable text-only transcription of NIOSH Publication 2024-100 on recognizing and responding to workplace heat illness. The 2023 source is useful but worker-focused; this pack is not a comprehensive first-aid manual or clinical review.

sources.name: NIOSH, Heat Stress: First Aid for Heat Illness, DHHS (NIOSH) Publication No. 2024-100, October 2023
sources.license: The exact CDC Stacks item is marked Public Domain. CDC reuse guidance requires agency attribution, a clear no-endorsement disclaimer, unchanged substantive text, and notice that the original is available without charge. The original PDF includes third-party stock photographs credited ©mycola/iStock and ©Thinkstock and CDC logos/marks; this pack transcribes the full textual content with layout normalized and excludes those images and marks. U.S. public-domain review only; international rights may differ.
